description: Single-claim answers about facts that change, each labelled against the authoritative page named in evidence_url as of the date below. STALE: the claim is contradicted by the page now. CURRENT: the page confirms it now. Labels were written by an AI coding agent from those pages and have not been reviewed by a human; the dataset is small and skews to software versions and support windows.
